posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is serving yellow fashion goals this summer while embracing life as a new mom with Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan — fans can’t get enough of their family moments.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit’s film ‘Main Vaapas Aaunga’ with Imtiaz Ali is creating major buzz, his Born to Shine world tour is breaking ticket records, and a Shakira collaboration is rumored.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia’s spy thriller ‘Alpha’ with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3 — she plays an assassin in YRF’s first female-led spy universe film.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is filming SS Rajamouli’s epic ‘Varanasi’ alongside Mahesh Babu in Hyderabad, while sharing poolside Sunday moments with Malti and Nick.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK’s action thriller ‘King’ with Siddharth Anand is nearing shoot completion for a Christmas 2026 release, while the Karan Johar unfollow drama has fans buzzing.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena has entered her ‘padel era’ and wrapped the ‘Daayra’ shoot, while celebrating Saba Pataudi’s 50th with the whole family.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha suffered a fracture on the sets of ‘Eetha’ and praised rumored partner Rahul Mody — plus her LinkedIn signup went viral.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is pregnant with her second child while filming ‘King’ with SRK and joining Allu Arjun’s ‘Raka’ — using a body double for action scenes.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer’s Don 3 exit has escalated with an FWICE non-cooperation directive against him. He was spotted with Arsenal’s Declan Rice in Budapest while ‘Pralay’ starts filming in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit came to Aishwarya’s defense against body-shaming over her stunning royal blue gown at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is everywhere promoting ‘Cocktail 2’ (June 19) with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon, and turned heads at the Anime Awards stage.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha married director Raj Nidimoru, dropped the teaser for ‘Maa Inti Bangaaram’, and joined Good Game as their global brand ambassador.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun’s mega film ‘Raka’ with director Atlee commands a record ₹175 cr pay. Pushpa 3 remains uncertain after a farewell-like anniversary post.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan’s rural sports drama ‘Peddi’ with Janhvi Kapoor and AR Rahman’s music hits theaters June 4. He also met PM Modi recently.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR dropped the ‘Dragon’ glimpse with Prashanth Neel on his birthday, unveiled the Devara Part 2 poster, and announced ‘God of War’ — three mega projects at once.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is promoting ‘Peddi’ with Ram Charan in stunning saree looks, and says she won’t attempt Malayalam cinema again after her last experience.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya’s ‘Chand Mera Dil’ crossed ₹20 cr in Week 1 at the box office. She defended herself gracefully amid Bharatanatyam trolling controversy.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara calls ‘Toxic’ with Yash ‘complete drama’ and gets candid about her postpartum journey with Sidharth Malhotra and baby Saraayah.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik announced his directorial debut with a social thriller in the works, while celebrating son Hrehaan’s 20th birthday and buying a new Andheri West property.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun’s rom-com ‘Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai’ with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde is out, amid the Vashu Bhagnani legal drama surrounding the David Dhawan film.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya purchased a ₹29.7 cr Worli luxury home, dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour, and refuses to sing objectifying songs — queen moves.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman reunites with Shekhar Kapur for ‘Masoom: The New Generation’ as composer and co-producer, while his ‘Peddi’ soundtrack with Ram Charan drops next week.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay’s TVK party won 108 seats in the Tamil Nadu 2026 Assembly elections. His final film ‘Jana Nayagan’ remains stuck in CBFC certification — the director says he lacks ‘courage’ to reveal why.
